items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that's the same article. Eddie Condon. I know Sharky's in that.

ctx.x: Firehouse five. Firehouse five. I had a marvelous cornet player at one time. Plus two. In there.
Those guys worked. Oh, man, they worked. Pollock. Ben Pollock. Yeah, Ben Pollock. Yeah. Was Eddie with it?
